Text.Text: The Reaver chief is dead, his dig is lost, and his buyers will wait for a shipment that never comes. You controlled the fight instead of feeding it. That is the beginning of Hunger of the Dark. Sit. The rest of the lesson is mine to give.

You want to be fed before you can hold the spoon. Your command of the Force is not ready for what waits on Mon Cala. Go and sharpen it. When the Force comes to you without begging, find me at this table again.

The Vitae Reavers, a Force-hungry crew riding with a relic expedition, have found a buyer for relics they barely understand. An old Sith tomb was broken open under the Sharptooth caves on Mon Cala, and the Reavers took it from the survey crews cataloguing it. Now they drain those crews, life and all, to fuel their dig in the Sith Crypt Depths. Crude. Wasteful. That makes them my business, and perhaps yours. Put down six Expedition Raiders, the hirelings nearest the entrance, and bring me the Hunger of the Dark Crypt Trial Tablet they took from the tombs. Any Expedition Raider counts, whichever crew they ride with, but only kills made with Force Drain, Force Lightning or Force Spark. A kill that took nothing from the Force teaches you nothing about hunger.

Take this key. It opens the sealed door in the old tomb wall, the purple stonework on the north side of the first cavern inside the Sharptooth Jungle Caves on Mon Cala. Six Expedition Raiders, killed with Force Drain, Force Lightning or Force Spark, and the tablet. Take only what you need from them.

Hunger of the Dark is the discipline of taking strength from a fight and spending only what the moment demands. The Reavers drain everything in reach and choke on it. Watch them, learn what not to do, and never mistake their excess for mastery.

Mon Cala. From the landing in Dac City, take the surface streets east through the inner and outer Coral Isles, then north-east into the Sharptooth Jungle. Keep north; a cave mouth on the north-east side of the northern jungle opens into the Sharptooth Jungle Caves. In the first cavern, look for a sealed door in the purple stone on the north side. I stay because their buyers drink here in Anchorhead. While you cut the supply, I will starve the market.

An independent band of Force-trained relic thieves, with no Sith commission and no master worth the name. Their raiders use stolen draining techniques on anyone who comes close. Most are human acolytes in cast-off Sith gear, and two Zabrak lead them: the enforcer and the chief.

Six Expedition Raiders, each killed with Force Drain, Force Lightning or Force Spark, and the tablet. The sealed door is on the north side of the first cavern in the Sharptooth Jungle Caves on Mon Cala. They will not starve themselves.
You have the Hunger of the Dark Crypt Trial Tablet. Set it on the table.
Etched with the tombs they have emptied, and the ones they mean to empty next. Their marauders have moved deeper with the relics. Eat. Rest. You will need both.

The raiders were the first course. Their Expedition Marauders carry the Hunger of the Dark Ritual Focus Shard, a relic that lets them draw more than their bodies can hold. Put down five Expedition Marauders, deeper in the Depths than the raiders, and bring the shard to me before one of them learns to use it properly. Any Marauder counts, but only kills made with Force Drain, Force Lightning or Force Spark.
Five Expedition Marauders, killed with Force Drain, Force Lightning or Force Spark, and the focus shard. They hunt the Depths in small packs. Let them come to you.

The shard sharpens a hunger into a blade. In a disciplined hand it is a tool. In theirs it is a crutch, and it is how they drain the crews so quickly. Take it, and they go back to being greedy amateurs.
Nowhere fixed. The Marauders range through the Depths in small packs, and one of them always carries the shard. Thin the packs and it will come to you.
They drain together, feeding one another. Break the chain. Finish the one who is drawing first, and do not let them feed on you while you are wounded.
Five Expedition Marauders and the shard, somewhere in the Sith Crypt Depths. They are still feeding.
You brought the Hunger of the Dark Ritual Focus Shard. Give it here. Slowly.
It still hums with what they took. I will see it emptied properly. Their enforcer is next, and he will not be a light meal.

Their enforcer, a Zabrak who goes by Expedition Captain Zarrik Thane, guards the trial altar on the east side of the Depths. He broke the Hunger of the Dark Splintered Tomb Sigil off a sealed tomb, and he keeps it on him. Go to that altar and he will come to meet you. Bring at least two allies. Bring me the sigil.
Good. The altar is on the east side of the Sith Crypt Depths. Make him come to you, let your allies wear him down, and take the sigil when he falls.
A Zabrak, the best they have. He has drained enough of the crews to stand through wounds that would drop most fighters. They placed him at the altar to keep anyone from following the dig.
It was broken off a sealed tomb entrance. The markings will tell me which tomb they forced and what they carried out of it. Their buyers would like to know that too. They will not get the chance.
Because a lone fighter is exactly what the enforcer feeds on. Three of you can split his attention and keep one another standing. Hunger without discipline dies alone. You will not.
The enforcer still holds the altar on the east side of the Depths. Two allies at your side, then the sigil.
You brought the Hunger of the Dark Splintered Tomb Sigil. Show me.
There. The tomb they forced, and the ones they have not reached. With the enforcer gone, only their Reavers stand between us and their chief.

Four of their senior acolytes, Expedition Reavers, now hold the way to the deep vaults, in the deepest part of the Depths. They carry the Hunger of the Dark Keeper's Rite Token, an old keeper's mark that opens the last sealed chambers. Put down four Expedition Reavers and bring me the token. Any Reaver counts, but only kills made with Force Drain, Force Lightning or Force Spark.
Four Expedition Reavers, killed with Force Drain, Force Lightning or Force Spark, and the token. They range through the Depths. Take them one at a time.
Human acolytes who came to the Reavers hungry and stayed for the stolen strength. They do the heavy work of the dig and the heavy work of killing. Do not pity them.
The tomb keepers carried it once. It opens the deepest vaults. As long as the Reavers hold it, nothing below is closed to them.
Never let all four reach you together. Choose your ground, keep your allies close, and watch the passage behind you. An acolyte who has fed on the Force does not tire easily.
Four Expedition Reavers and the token, somewhere in the Sith Crypt Depths.
You brought the Hunger of the Dark Keeper's Rite Token. Set it down.
Good. The vaults stay shut. Only their chief remains, and he has nowhere left to run.

Their chief, a Zabrak they call Expedition Leader Mordek Sull, has taken the last relics into the Final Ritual Chamber, through the door at the north end of the Depths. He has been drinking from the crews for weeks, and he will be strong. Bring at least two allies and end him before he moves the shipment.
Go together. The Final Ritual Chamber is through the north door of the Sith Crypt Depths. Take what you need from the fight, and nothing more.
The chief himself, gorged on what he drained from the crews and on the relics around him. Break him there, and the surviving crews can walk out.
He draws on the stolen relics and on everyone near him. He will try to wear you down and feed on whoever falters. Stay close, keep each other standing, and give him no moment's rest.
I finish with their buyers here in Anchorhead. Once the chief is gone, there is no shipment left to buy. When you return, the records you recovered will tell us what they stole, and who wanted it.
Expedition Leader Mordek Sull waits in the Final Ritual Chamber, at the north end of the Depths. Take your allies.
Expedition Leader Mordek Sull is down. Tell me how it went.

The Reaver chief is dead, his dig is lost, and his buyers will wait for a shipment that never comes. You controlled the fight instead of feeding it. That is the beginning of Hunger of the Dark. Sit. The rest of the lesson is mine to give.

Junix's Joint in Anchorhead has customers who know better than to ask who taught a stranger. My lessons answer to no academy, and I don't care whose banner you carry. I care whether you can control what you take. The Vitae Reavers are in the Sith Crypt Depths on Mon Cala, beneath the Sharptooth Jungle Caves. Bring their records back to this table on Tatooine.
Go over the first assignment.
I'll go down and bring back the tablet.
What does this discipline teach?
Where do I go, and why are you staying here?
Who or what will I be fighting?
I need to prepare first.
Here is the recovered tablet.
Go over the next objective.
I will recover the focus shard.
Why does the shard matter?
Where do they keep it?
How do they fight?
I need more time.
Here is the focus shard.
Go over the enforcer again.
I'll bring two allies and take the sigil.
Who is the enforcer?
Why recover the broken sigil?
Why bring a group?
I will gather my companions first.
The enforcer is dead. Here is the sigil.
Go over the four Reavers again.
I'll deal with the four Reavers.
Who are these Reavers?
What does the token do?
How should we approach them?
I need to rest first.
Here is the recovered token.
Go over the final objective.
We will go in together.
What is waiting in the last chamber?
What makes the leader dangerous?
What happens after this?
My companions need to prepare.
The final target is down. We made it out.
Why are we meeting here, and where is the trial?
Back to the assignment.
